software_steps.mechanism: Signed testbed qualification checks active 5G and LEO service, independent route observation, emergency restore, clocks, session preservation, permissions, and the frozen ledger schema.

An immutable campaign-registry lock enforces development, gate-evidence, canary, and untouched-test roles, minimum campaign and acquisition-family eligibility, non-overlap, raw-telemetry hashes, and separately bound gate-opportunity hashes.
Loss-preserving synchronized telemetry ingestion retains replies, losses, timeouts, RF, beam, handover, route, timing, and application or EO outcome fields with identity and hash audits.
The signed frozen gate accepts confirmatory evidence only when metrics are recomputed from role-correct, hash-locked per-campaign opportunity tables bound to the trial freeze.
The rejection branch blocks candidate mutation, independently verifies baseline FIB and first-packet state, exercises rollback, and signs the resulting proof.

The authorization branch freezes canary assignment, evaluates all registered safety triggers, verifies stopped-canary rollback, requires signed no-retuning approval, and separately freezes the untouched final-test plan.

The action-outcome ledger reconciles intended, installed, acknowledged, first-packet, rollback, full-loop timing, assignment, and authenticated endpoint outcome records before conservative intention-to-treat analysis.

campaign_count_boundary.interpretation: Conservative confirmatory eligibility profile only; not a universal statistical minimum and not a substitute for blinded pilot power and precision planning.

external_dependencies: Supervisor and operator approval of the endpoint effect margin and safety thresholds
Cellular/5G modem with timestamped telemetry and an active data plan
LEO terminal with permitted telemetry and an active service plan
Dual-access gateway capable of verified route or tunnel installation
Session-preserving MP-QUIC MPTCP or anchored-tunnel path control
Remote anchor and application endpoint under experimenter control
Synchronized clocks with recorded worst-case error
Role-separated development gate-evidence and untouched final-test acquisition families
Timestamped packet loss timeouts route state and first-packet observations
Operational application or EO tasks with sizes deadlines validity and final delivery outcomes
Required institutional ethics spectrum network-change and operator permissions

external_execution_steps.action: Obtain approved cellular/5G and LEO terminals, a dual-access gateway, a controlled remote anchor, active service, and required institutional and operator permissions.
Collect role-separated development, gate-evidence, and untouched final-test acquisition families.
Preserve synchronized losses, timeouts, RF/beam/handover observations, installed-route evidence, and operational application or EO outcomes.
Verify safe baseline retention and complete the registered rollback drill.
external_execution_steps.claim_boundary: A verified negative gate decision is a valid prospective safety result but does not support candidate benefit.

external_execution_steps.action: Execute the predefined canary and then the untouched final test without retuning; assess benefit only against the prespecified performance and safety criteria.
Reconcile proposed and installed routes, installation acknowledgements, first post-installation packets, complete controller-loop latency, and final application or EO outcomes.

claim_boundary: Objective 4 is complete within the declared bounded offline integration and evaluation scope. All seven protocol mechanisms are implemented and adversarially tested in software, including a FAKE_DRIVER_TEST rehearsal of rejection and authorization branches. The repository does not contain completed live field observations and must not be described as a completed prospective field trial or as evidence of deployment benefit.
